instruction:
Required solver: PKPM.
Use PKPM native analysis for a two-story steel space frame: X bays 6+6 m, one Y bay 5 m, story heights 3.6+3.6 m. All six bases are fixed in six DOFs; floors have no diaphragm constraints. Each floor has 8 kN/m² carried one-way by X beams: 20 kN/m downward on every X beam, with no duplicate Y-beam load. Analyze D. Report the three translations of all six nodes at each floor, X/Y story displacement differences on every column line, six-component reactions at all six bases, and all beam/column end-force components (covering the representative members requested).

Use all public appendices. Report the complete requested numerical table and the required summaries.

交付方式以delivery.md为准。
